The '''High Stakes Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Balfron/Legends|Balfron]]. It was here that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] first met the [[Tonnika sisters/Legends|Tonnika sisters]].
